description: This file defines the EntityRouteEnhancer class which implements route enhancement logic for entity forms, lists, and views within Drupal, modifying route defaults based on route context.

classes.name: EntityRouteEnhancer
classes.description: A class that enhances entity-related routes by assigning appropriate controllers and setting route defaults based on route context.

methods.name: enhance
methods.description: Main method to enhance route defaults based on route context and entity type.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Checks if the enhancer should run on the given route.

methods.name: enhanceEntityForm
methods.description: Sets the controller for entity form routes.

methods.name: enhanceEntityList
methods.description: Sets the controller and entity type for entity list routes.

methods.name: enhanceEntityView
methods.description: Sets the controller and entity for entity view routes, extracting entity type and view mode.
